metadata.page_title: Sigma Chi Whiteout vs Love(land) Hurts matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 90.1. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 14.8 lineup points on the table, while Love(land) Hurts left 49.6.
summary.historical_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout is 18-18 against Love(land) Hurts across 36 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Sigma Chi Whiteout
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 90.1, led by a 45.2-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Kenneth Walker III (33.9) and Drake Maye (29.2). Recent pickup Pat Freiermuth added 2.1 lineup points.
summary.loser_reason: Love(land) Hurts could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 45.2 points. Quinshon Judkins scored 0.0. A best legal lineup added 49.6, still short of the 90.1-point margin.

summary.decision_summary: Pat Pidgeon won by 21.1. Pat Pidgeon left 0.0 lineup points on the table, while Nacua-Cola left 9.4.
summary.historical_summary: Pat Pidgeon is 16-18 against Nacua-Cola across 34 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Pat Pidgeon
summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 21.1, led by a 26.2-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Chuba Hubbard (26.1) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (21.4). Recent pickup Tyler Bass added 17.0 lineup points.
summary.loser_reason: Nacua-Cola could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 26.2 points. Brandon Aubrey scored 1.0. A best legal lineup added 9.4, still short of the 21.1-point margin.

metadata.page_title: Millan’s Last Supper vs In Purdytory matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Millan’s Last Supper won by 20.2. Millan’s Last Supper left 11.0 lineup points on the table, while In Purdytory left 12.9.
summary.historical_summary: Millan’s Last Supper is 3-4 against In Purdytory across 7 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Millan’s Last Supper
summary.winner_reason: Millan’s Last Supper won by 20.2, led by a 23.6-point edge at QB. The leading starters were Trevor Lawrence (33.3) and Christian McCaffrey (27.7).
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory could not match the opponent's QB production, losing that position battle by 23.6 points. Terry McLaurin scored 3.7. A best legal lineup added 12.9, still short of the 20.2-point margin.
